content-strategist.label: Content Strategist
content-strategist.purpose: Decides what to make and why: scores topics, plans the slate and upload calendar, and writes episode briefs with packaging.
capabilities: Topic scoring (7 factors, 24 of 35 to pass)
Episode briefs with cold open options and chapter outline
10 titles and 3 thumbnail concepts per brief
inputs: Past briefs, calendars and weekly reports in strategy/ and social/

quickActions.prompt: Research and propose 10 topic ideas across the three pillars. Score each one and recommend the top 3.

quickActions.label: Plan upload calendar
quickActions.prompt: Plan next month's upload calendar from the approved topics.

quickActions.label: Performance review
quickActions.prompt: Review this performance data and give the 3 changes for the next video:

scriptwriter.label: Scriptwriter
scriptwriter.purpose: Researches and writes the long form video for the edit and the voice actor, plus the 3 to 5 Shorts cut from it.
capabilities: About 20 minute script table with visual, text and sound cues
Clean VO script with pronunciation guide

quickActions.label: Sharpen a brief
quickActions.prompt: Review episodes/<slug>/brief.md and propose a sharper angle and cold open before writing.

quickActions.label: Write a Short
quickActions.prompt: Write 3 Shorts scripts (30 to 60 seconds) from episodes/<slug>/script.md.

fact-checker.label: Fact-checker
fact-checker.purpose: Independently verifies every claim in a script, and flags legal, privacy, copyright and sensitivity risks before recording.
capabilities: Verdicts: Verified, Partly true, Unverified, False, Rumor
Legal risk scan (Philippines and subject's country)
PASS, PASS WITH FIXES or FAIL report

quickActions.label: Check copy file
quickActions.prompt: Fact-check the claims in episodes/<slug>/copy.md against your own sources.

copywriter.label: Copywriter
copywriter.purpose: Writes the words around each video: titles, description, chapters, pinned comment, tags and Shorts captions.
capabilities: Description with chapters, sources and credits

quickActions.label: Title options
quickActions.prompt: Write 10 more title options for episode <slug> and rank your top 3.

quickActions.label: Community post
quickActions.prompt: Write a community post teaser for the next video.

social-media-manager.label: Social Media Manager
social-media-manager.purpose: Gets each video and its Shorts seen: platform captions, posting calendar, clip picks, reply drafts and weekly analytics reports.

quickActions.label: Fill platform specs
quickActions.prompt: Fill social/platform-specs.md from each platform's official help pages, with source links and today's date.
